extractions.tool: convert.py: one row per (model key, skill) of the 77 data keys the legacy rows cite (results/skills-30m/_data.js, window.COMBINED_DATA[key][skill], numbers copied; finalXp_e5 = finalXp / 100000 exactly, 5 decimals (the unit of the metric xp-x1e5); costUsd = tokenUsage.costUsd as stored (python repr); agentStartedAt, containerFinishedAt, jobName verbatim). convert.py: displayName of each key from MODEL_CONFIG of views/shared-constants.js, verbatim; effort_label = its last word when that word is one of low/medium/high/xhigh/max (a slice of the displayName, no other source).
